name: 3DGR-CT Gaussian Voxelization
definition: A CUDA kernel that computes the contribution of 3D Gaussians to a voxel grid. It uses a localized computation within a 3*sigma bounding box to reduce computational burden. It employs a work-stealing approach for balanced workload distribution among thread blocks and uses shared memory to cache Gaussian parameters.
summary: 3DGR-CT Gaussian Voxelization is a CUDA method mapping 3D Gaussians to voxel grids for sparse-view CT reconstruction, distinguished by its work-stealing kernel with shared memory caching and atomic operations.
